questions.question: What type of insurance plan is Kotak Premier Life Plan?
questions.expected_answer: A limited premium paying non-linked participating whole life plan

questions.question: Until what age does the Kotak Premier Life Plan offer protection?
questions.expected_answer: 99 years (golden age)

questions.question: What are the two bonus options available under the Kotak Premier Life Plan?
questions.expected_answer: Cash Payout and Paid-Up Additions

questions.question: When is Simple Reversionary Bonus declared under the plan?
questions.expected_answer: From 1st policy year till the end of Premium payment term

questions.question: What is paid at maturity under the Kotak Premier Life Plan?
questions.expected_answer: Sum Assured on maturity plus accrued Paid-Up Additions (if any) plus Cash Bonus (if any) plus Terminal Bonus (if any)

questions.question: What is included in Death Benefit if death occurs during the premium payment term?
questions.expected_answer: Sum Assured on death Plus Accrued Simple Reversionary Bonuses (if any) Plus Terminal Bonus (if any)

questions.question: What is included in Death Benefit if death occurs after premium payment term but during policy term?
questions.expected_answer: Sum Assured on death Plus Accrued Paid-Up Additions (if any) Plus Terminal Bonus (if any)

questions.question: How is Sum Assured on death defined in the plan?
questions.expected_answer: Higher of: 11 times of Annualised Premium, or Sum Assured on maturity, or 105% of premiums paid till date of death (excluding GST and Cess)

questions.question: When can a policyholder change the bonus option selected at inception?
questions.expected_answer: Within 3 months prior to the end of premium payment term

questions.question: What happens if the request to change bonus option is not received within the defined time frame?
questions.expected_answer: The policy will continue as per the Option selected at inception

questions.question: Under Cash Payout option, when is Simple Reversionary Bonus payable?
questions.expected_answer: At the end of the premium payment term

questions.question: Under Paid-Up Additions option, what happens to Simple Reversionary Bonus?
questions.expected_answer: It will be utilized to purchase Paid-Up Additions

questions.question: What are Paid-Up Additions?
questions.expected_answer: Additional guaranteed benefits payable on death or maturity

questions.question: At what age is the Paid-Up Addition Factor 1.69812 for standard lives?
questions.expected_answer: 35 years (on exercising Paid-Up Addition option)

questions.question: What happens to a Reduced Paid-Up Policy regarding Simple Reversionary Bonus and Cash Bonus?
questions.expected_answer: Not eligible after conversion to Reduced Paid-Up

questions.question: How many times can policyholders encash Paid-Up Additions in a policy year?
questions.expected_answer: Maximum of 6 times

questions.question: What is the minimum encashment amount for Paid-Up Additions?
At what age is the Cash Value factor for Paid-Up Additions 0.673496?
questions.expected_answer: 55 years (on exercising encashment of Paid-Up Additions)

questions.question: Under Maturity Benefit, what components are payable on survival till end of policy term?
questions.expected_answer: Sum Assured on maturity Plus Cash Bonus (if any) plus accrued Paid-Up Additions (if any) plus Terminal Bonus (if any)

questions.question: What tax benefits are available under the plan?
questions.expected_answer: Under Section 80C and Section 10(10D) of Income Tax Act, 1961

questions.question: What is the maximum entry age for a policy with 55 years PPT?
questions.expected_answer: 8 years

questions.question: At what maximum age can one enter the plan with a premium payment term of 20 years?
questions.expected_answer: 45 years

questions.question: What are the fixed premium payment term options available?
questions.expected_answer: 8, 12, 15 and 20 years

questions.question: What is the policy term for Kotak Premier Life Plan?
questions.expected_answer: 99 years or 99 years less entry age

questions.question: What is the maximum sum assured on maturity available under the plan?
questions.expected_answer: No limit, subject to underwriting

questions.question: What is the minimum premium required for the Kotak Premier Life Plan?
What are the available premium payment modes?
questions.expected_answer: Yearly, Half yearly, Quarterly, Monthly

questions.question: What is the modal factor for monthly premium payment as a percentage of annual premium?
Which rider provides additional protection over and above the Death Benefit under the base plan?
questions.expected_answer: Kotak Term Benefit Rider (UIN: 107B003V03)

questions.question: What benefit does Kotak Accidental Death Benefit Rider provide?
questions.expected_answer: Lump sum benefit paid on accidental death of life insured in addition to Death Benefit under the base plan

questions.question: What does Kotak Permanent Disability Benefit Rider provide?
questions.expected_answer: Installments paid on admission of a claimon life insured becoming disabled due to accident

questions.question: Which rider pays remaining premiums on behalf of the policyholder in case of his/her death?
questions.expected_answer: Kotak Life Guardian Benefit Rider (UIN: 107B012V02)

questions.question: What does Kotak Critical Illness Plus Benefit Rider cover?
questions.expected_answer: Rider Sum Assured shall be payable on admission of a claim on any one of the 37 covered critical illness

questions.question: What is the minimum entry age for Kotak Premier Life Plan?
questions.expected_answer: 3 years

questions.question: For which policy modes is the grace period 30 days?
questions.expected_answer: Yearly, half-yearly and quarterly modes

questions.question: What is the grace period for monthly mode premium payment?
questions.expected_answer: 15 days

questions.question: What is the interest rate currently charged on policy loans?
What percentage of Surrender Value can be availed as a loan?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 80%

questions.question: What is the minimum loan amount available under the plan?
If premiums are discontinued in the first two policy years, what happens to the policy?
questions.expected_answer: The policy shall lapse at the end of the grace period and no benefits will be payable

questions.question: Within how many years can a lapsed policy be reinstated without evidence of good health?
questions.expected_answer: Within five years from the date of first unpaid premium (if within six months)

questions.question: What is the late payment charge for revival of policy?
questions.expected_answer: 9% p.a. of outstanding premiums

questions.question: After how many consecutive policy years does a policy acquire Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV)?
questions.expected_answer: 2 years

questions.question: What percentage of total premiums paid is the GSV factor for 3rd year surrender?
What percentage of total premiums paid is the GSV factor for 4th to 7th year surrender?
At what rate does the GSV factor reach 90%?
questions.expected_answer: In the last policy year

questions.question: If the Reduced Paid-Up Sum Assured on maturity is less than ₹1,250 exclusive of attached bonuses, what happens after revival period expires?
questions.expected_answer: Policy may be terminated by paying the Surrender Value

questions.question: What percentage of premiums paid till date of death shall be payable in case of suicide within 12 months from date of commencement of risk?
Under the illustration provided, what is the Sum Assured on maturity for the example male aged 35 years?
questions.expected_answer: ₹10 Lakhs

questions.question: For the illustration with premium payment term of 15 years, what is the Total Maturity Benefit at higher rate (8% p.a.) in the end of policy year?
What are the assumed rates of return used in the illustration?
questions.expected_answer: 4% p.a. for lower rate and 8% p.a. for higher rate
